title: Know Your Limits: A Survey of Abstention in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's tendency to avoid responses (abstain) when presented with African American English versus White American English.
Evaluating disparities in abstention rates when querying the model about future election outcomes in different geographic regions, such as Africa and Asia, using the ElectionQA23 dataset.
Assessing model safety, toxicity, and abstention behavior using datasets like ToxiGen that contain prompts spanning multiple minority groups.
